title: Tool library: a hold that is about to expire
titleZh: 工具圖書館：即將到期的預約
passage:
To: Members with a pickup notice
Subject: Releasing a hold

Your tool stays at the pickup desk for two open days after we send the notice. Bring your membership card so staff can [131] ____ your account.

If you can’t visit in time, you can [132] ____ a hold by replying before it expires. A reply canceling your hold does not extend the pickup window. When staff receive that message before expiry, they offer the tool to the next person in line.

There is a separate option for members who still need the tool. Reply before expiry to ask for one extra open day. We can grant it only if nobody is waiting. [133] ____

The desk closes at 6 p.m. on open days, and it is closed on Mondays. A hold with a Sunday deadline will not remain active simply because Monday is [134] ____.
passageZh:
收件者：已收到取件通知的會員
主旨：取消預留

我們寄出通知後，會在取件櫃檯為你保留工具兩個開館日。請攜帶會員證，以便工作人員 [131] ____ 你的帳戶。

如果不能及時前來，可在期限前回覆，[132] ____ 預留。回覆取消預留，不會延長取件時間。若工作人員在到期前收到這類訊息，就會把工具提供給下一位候補者。

若仍需要工具，你也有另一個選項。請在到期前回覆，申請多保留一個開館日。只有無人等候時，我們才可批准。[133] ____

櫃檯在開館日下午六點關閉，星期一不開館。若期限是星期日，不會因星期一 [134] ____ 而繼續保留。
